_meta.what: Entities a story may be illustrated with. Matched longest-first against a story's Norwegian title; the first match wins and a story gets at most one image.
_meta.why_no_people: No person names. Commons has file photos of most Norwegian politicians, and putting one beside a story about an accusation against them illustrates the accusation, not the subject. Places and institutions carry no such implication.
_meta.rule: The picture illustrates the ENTITY, never the event. The site captions it that way.
